definitions.gloss: therefore; for that reason; because of that
definitions.explanation: indicates that what follows is a result or consequence of what was mentioned before

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。そのため、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: The train was delayed. Therefore, I didn't make it to the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}している→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。そのため、⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: He practices every day. That's why he's improving quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。そのため、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There was an accident. As a result, the road is congested.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ (that) + ⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧ (reason, sake)

USAGE:
- Used at the beginning of a sentence to connect to the previous one
- Can also be used within a sentence: ～、そのため～
- Common in formal writing and speeches

SIMILAR WORDS:
- だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ - therefore (more casual)
- したがって - consequently (more formal)
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ - so, and so
- ゆえ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - hence (formal/literary)

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ + noun pattern:
- ⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧ - after that
- ⟦その{前|まえ}→その前：08502_sonomae⟧ - before that
- ⟦その{間|あいだ}→その間：08503_sonoaida⟧ - meanwhile
